eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Yakima, WA; at 1:38 PM on AUG 30, 2016 Effective until 2:38 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a test, only a test of the Emergency Alert System being conducted by Yakima County 9-1-1.  In the event of an emergency, this system would bring you important information.  The following tones will conclude the test.
